name: V.I.C.
notes: The electro end of ColliPark snap, and it is the brightest and busiest model on this axis. The research's parameters are all in one direction — "a synth arpeggio implying i–VI", "brighter/major-leaning than crunk", "higher note density than 2005-era snap (electro influence)" — so `i–VI` leads `progressionFamilies`, `session.scales` carries `major` at weight 2 where the rest of this lane carries it at 0 or 1, `melody.densityPerBar` is [6, 10] against the archetype's [2, 5], and `chordToneBias` is 0.88 because an arpeggio *is* chord tones. The electro noise clap on the hook is `layerClapOffsetMs` [3, 7], the widest in the batch — the two claps are meant to be heard as two. The whistle and vox stabs "used as percussion" are the `perc` lane rather than a melodic part, which is the honest place for them. ⛔ **`confidence` is low, and the research is why**: it rates this medium-low — "producer/era sourced; parameters inferred" — with the 72–82 half-time band marked [LOW-CONF]. So `session.bpm` 144–164 is inferred, and so is every drum number below it; what is actually sourced is the ColliPark credit, the year, and the palette (saw lead, bells, noise clap, whistle stabs). ⚠ **The short glide into the downbeat is approximated, not authored as described.** `bass808.slidePositions` only knows `phrase_end` in this dataset, so the glide is expressed as a raised `slideProb` (0.2, the highest here) landing at phrase ends rather than on every downbeat. ⚠ The electro synth-bass doubling the 808 on the hook is **not expressible**: `drums.bass808.role` is `bassline` throughout this lane, which means the separate bass generator returns nothing, and authoring a `bassline` block that can never sound would be authoring dead parameters. ⚠ `anticipationProb` raised to 0.15. With `mirror_kick` against a fully locked 808 both parts take every kick, so every bass onset lands exactly on an 808 onset — `coherence.rs` calls that one line played twice rather than two parts locking. The lock is the style and is untouched; the anticipation is what makes them two parts. ⚠ **The 1-bar phrase length was removed** (was [2,1], now [2,4]). A one-bar phrase looped four times carries less entropy than a four-bar phrase, and it is the countermelody it strangles hardest: a counter answers *inside* the melody’s phrase, so a one-bar shape leaves it nowhere to go. Every worst offender on `counter.rs` carried it. ⛔ The previous session recorded this exact mistake and it arrived again from the other direction — distinctness is combinatorial in the shape LENGTH, not in the option count.
